top.hero-open: Open 9 am to 9 pm, Monday to Saturday
top.h1: Paint, pipe, wire and every small thing in between.
top.p: One shop on Diamond Harbour Road for the whole job. Emulsion matched to your shade in twenty minutes, plumbing and electrical fittings by the piece, tools, and cement and sand delivered to your gate by our own van.

stock.p: If it goes into a house, a shop or a flat, we most likely have it. If we do not, we get it in two days.

items.p: Emulsion, enamel, distemper, primer, putty, brushes and rollers. Shade matching on the spot.
PVC, CPVC and GI pipe, taps, elbows, valves, tank fittings, Teflon and solvent.
Copper wire by the coil, modular switches, MCBs, boards, fans, LED bulbs and tube lights.
Hammers, spanners, drill bits, hacksaws, measuring tape, levels. Drill machines on order.
Cement by the bag, sand and stone chips by the cft, bricks by the hundred. Delivered, not carried.
Hinges, locks, tower bolts, screws by weight, wall plugs, door closers, curtain rods.

paints.p: Bring a photo, a swatch or a piece of the old wall. We mix the shade while you wait and write the code on the tin so you can buy the same shade next year.

photo.alt: A paint roller resting on a ladder beside a half-painted red wall

paints.p2: Washable interior emulsion for bedrooms and living rooms. Weather-proof exterior emulsion for the front of the house and the terrace wall. Economy, mid and premium grades on the shelf. One litre covers about 100 sq ft in two coats.

photo2.alt: Two painters on a bamboo ladder painting a tall outside wall blue

paints.h32: Enamel for grills, doors and windows
paints.p3: Oil-based gloss enamel for iron grills, gates, wooden doors and window frames. Dries hard, resists rust, cleans with a wet cloth. Available in matt too for furniture.

photo3.alt: A painter seated on a rope platform applying white paint to a building wall

paints.h33: Distemper for rented rooms and ceilings
paints.p4: The cheapest clean wall you can get. Acrylic distemper for ceilings, staircases, godowns and rented flats where you repaint every two years. Sold by the kilo, mixed with water at home.

photo4.alt: A spread of paint colour swatches fanned out on a table

paints.p5: Our tinting machine mixes over 2,400 shades from four base whites. Bring any colour and we match it. Before the colour goes on, the wall needs putty to fill and primer to hold. We will tell you how much you need if you give us the room size.

contractors.h2: Site rates for anyone buying for a site.
contractors.p: Thirty-odd painters and masons in Behala buy from us every week. Here is what they get that a walk-in customer does not.

items.b: 8 to 12 percent off the counter price
items.p: On paint above 40 litres, wire above 5 coils, cement above 50 bags. The rate is written on the bill, not whispered.

items.b: One GST bill for the whole site
items.p: Give us the owner's or the firm's GST number once. Every delivery goes on the same account and one bill comes at the end of the month.
Our van and two helpers carry cement and paint to the floor you are working on, up to the fourth floor without a lift.
Sealed tins and unopened bags come back within 15 days for full credit. Tinted shades are the exception, since nobody else will buy them.

items.b: Fifteen days credit after the third job
items.p: New contractors pay on delivery. Once we have done three sites together, the account runs on fifteen days credit.
WhatsApp the item list with quantities, the site address and the floor. A photo of the engineer's list is fine.

items.b: Get the rate in an hour
items.p: We reply with the site rate, the delivery day and the total. Nothing moves until you say yes.
Count the bags at the gate, sign the challan, and the material goes up. Payment on delivery or on account.

Cement, sand and bricks are delivered within 48 hours of order
Helpers carry up to the fourth floor at no extra charge
Painters charge about ₹14 to ₹22 per sq ft for two coats, labour only
Plumbers and electricians for small jobs, usually within two days
They buy the material here, so if something is wrong we hear about it
You pay them directly. We take nothing from either side

faq.h2: Things people ask before they come.

items.summary: Can you match a shade from a photo or an old wall?
items.div: Yes. A chip of the old paint is best, a swatch card from any company is fine, and a photo works for most shades. The machine takes about twenty minutes. We write the shade code on your tin so the same colour can be mixed again later.

items.summary: Do you deliver, and what does it cost?
items.div: Our van delivers twice a day inside Behala. It is free on bills above ₹3,000 and ₹150 below that. Nearby areas such as Thakurpukur, Joka and New Alipore are ₹250 flat. Cement, sand and bricks are always delivered.

items.summary: How long does cement or sand take?
items.div: We do not keep cement in the shop. Order today and it comes from the depot within 48 hours, usually next day. Sand and stone chips take two to three days because the truck is shared with other orders. Minimum 10 bags of cement for delivery.

items.summary: Can I return paint I did not use?
items.div: Sealed tins of white or ready shades, yes, within 15 days with the bill. Tinted shades mixed for you cannot be returned because nobody else will buy that colour. Opened tins cannot be returned either.

items.summary: Do you give a GST bill?
items.div: Every sale gets a printed bill with our GST number. If you want the bill in a firm's name with its GST number, tell us before billing and it goes on the bill.

items.summary: Do you give credit to contractors?
items.div: Not on the first job. After three sites bought and paid on time, a contractor's account runs on fifteen days credit with a monthly statement. Walk-in customers pay at the counter, by cash, UPI or card.

section-10.h2: From the people who buy here.

items.p: I took a photo of my mother's old bedroom wall and they matched it. Nobody can tell where the new patch starts. The tin had the code written on it for next time.
I paint flats in Behala and Joka. Sixty litres a month from here, one bill, delivered to the floor. They tell me when a shade is going to look different in daylight, which has saved me twice.
